data.name: Adhit
data.gender_notes: Adhit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adhit is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'adh' which means 'to rule' or 'to lead'. The name is associated with gods like Indra and Vishnu, who are often referred to as the rulers of the universe. Adhit is a powerful name, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and the ability to guide and protect. The name Adhit carries the meaning “Leader, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adhit usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
